concepts.net_velocity: endpoint count difference / actual elapsed seconds; units accounts/s or accounts/h
concepts.net_acceleration: adjacent interval velocity difference / elapsed interval-midpoint seconds; accounts/s^2 or accounts/h^2
concepts.weighted_average: first-to-last timed net change / total elapsed seconds, not the unweighted mean of speeds
concepts.blue_membership: observed list membership may include badge upgrades, renames and collection changes; not new-blue acquisition
concepts.quality_bounds: high/N to (high+unknown)/N for the observed cohort; no population confidence claim
concepts.conversion: follower net change divided by post views is not a matched conversion rate

limitations: Count slopes are observations, not strategy effects or forecasts.
Missing timestamps or counts are skipped, never assigned invented times or zeros.
Each post and each edited status ID retains its own counter window.
Acceleration describes a finite-difference estimate; it does not prove exponential growth.
